title: SREV-137 Ldr init entrypoint instruction cache coherency

initial_patch.description: Ldr_Inject_Init writes architecture-specific executable entrypoint stub bytes

restore_patch.description: Ldr_Inject_Entry restores the saved original executable entrypoint bytes

flush_gate.description: NtFlushInstructionCache covers the mutated entrypoint range after code bytes are written

policy_invariant.description: Patch bytes, entrypoint routing, host-injection policy, and DLL loading order are unchanged

contracts: VirtualProtect changes committed page protection but does not by itself prove instruction-cache coherency
Generated or modified executable code must be followed by FlushInstructionCache
Ldr_Inject_Init must flush entrypoint, LDR_INJECT_NUM_SAVE_BYTES after writing the architecture-specific entrypoint stub
Ldr_Inject_Entry must flush entrypoint, LDR_INJECT_NUM_SAVE_BYTES after restoring saved original bytes and restoring page protection
The entrypoint mutation range remains LDR_INJECT_NUM_SAVE_BYTES on ARM64, x64, and x86
This SREV does not change entrypoint patch bytes, entrypoint address calculation, host-injection policy, F-Secure stack-zero compatibility, or DLL loading order
